chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from Muawiya ibn 'Ammar, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the man who gives an advance payment regarding the animals or the foodstuff, and he holds the security deposit as the mortgage. He (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no problem; you secure your wealth from your owner.'
ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to give an advance payment for goods while holding a security deposit?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) validates the permissibility of combining a *salam* contract (advance payment for specific goods like animals or food) with a pledge (*rahn*) as a security measure. This ruling highlights the practical flexibility in Shia commercial jurisprudence, allowing parties to mitigate risk by securing the debtor's obligation through collateral while ensuring the delivery of the specified commodity.
